top_signals.title: US Stock Futures Drop After Earnings, Oil Gains: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: US equity-index futures fell after mixed earnings from megacap companies cast doubt on the durability of this week’s rebound in the artificial intelligence trade. Crude oil climbed as tensions flared in the Middle East.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
